Sixteen silver denarii from the same field were reported for consideration as Treasure. According to the finder only nine coins were found within close proximity of one another: Silver Republican denarius of Flaminius Cilo. Mint of Rome: 109 or 108 BC (Reece Period 1). RRC 302/1. Obverse inscription: ROMA, mark X - Helmeted head of Roma right. Reverse inscription: L FLAMINI CILO- Victory in biga right. Diameter: 17.99mm; thickness: 1.67mm; weight: 3.51g. Silver Republican denarius serratus of Naevius Balbus. Mint of Rome: 79 BC (Reece Period 1). RRC 382/1b. Obverse inscription: S C - Head of Venus right. Reverse inscription: C NAE BALB, control-mark (CXXXVIIII) - Victory in triga right.…
